title: Стенд штопора SR-К1, база и гипотезы 1 и 3 (крутка, sport против laminar)
goal: Стенд модели tools/research/spin_recovery/spin_run.gd по SR-К1; база (игра, без pitch_nl, без отпускания рук VM-12) и гипотезы 1 (крутка sport 12, 14°) и 3 (параметры laminar в sport по одному и все вместе): выходит ли sport, время и потеря высоты, по SR-К2.

accept.name: sr2-variants
accept.cmd: python3 -I -c "import json,sys; s=json.load(open('tools/research/spin_recovery/out/sr-2/summary.json')); R=s['rows']; d=lambda r: abs(r['dt']-1/120)<1e-9; need=['game','pnl_off','rel_off','wash12','wash14','lam_tipchord','lam_dihedral','lam_washout','lam_sweep','lam_all']; have={(r['variant'],r['mode']) for r in R if r['wing']=='sport' and d(r)}; miss=[(v,m) for v in need for m in ('release','standard') if (v,m) not in have]; tr=[r for r in R if r['wing']=='training' and r['variant']=='game' and r['mode']=='standard' and d(r)]; g={r['wing']:r['trim_kmh'] for r in R if r['variant']=='game' and d(r)}; bad=[(r['wing'],r['variant'],r['dt']) for r in R if abs(r['trim_kmh']-g[r['wing']])>0.1]; dts={r['dt'] for r in R if r['variant']=='game' and r['wing']=='sport'}; ok=not miss and bool(tr) and tr[0]['recovered'] and not bad and len(dts)>=3; print('sr2 ok' if ok else ('bad',miss,bool(tr and tr[0]['recovered']),bad[:5],sorted(dts))); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"
